title: VibeSec 人工裁決 / VibeSec Human Ruling
description: 人工對 requires_human 發現的裁決紀錄（docs/09 §12）。只決定 validation_status 與（有證據時）evidence_grade；不改嚴重度、CVSS、policy_tier，也不刪除任何模型意見。 / Human adjudication of a requires_human finding (docs/09 section 12). Changes validation/evidence only; never severity, CVSS, policy tier, or model opinions.

type.description: 裁決者必須是人；模型或 bot 不得裁決 / The adjudicator must be human, never a model or bot.

handle.description: GitHub 帳號或工號 / GitHub handle or employee identifier.

role.description: 例如 appsec-lead、tech-lead / For example appsec-lead or tech-lead.

decision.description: confirm → validation_status confirmed 且 E3；refute → refuted；defer → 維持 pending 並保留 requires_human / Confirm sets confirmed/E3; refute sets refuted; defer preserves pending and requires_human.

basis.description: 裁決依據。模型共識不是依據（docs/09 §4） / Adjudication basis. Model consensus is not evidence (docs/09 section 4).

evidence_refs.description: 裁決所依據的證據；model_review 不算 / Supporting evidence; model_review does not qualify.

rationale.description: 為什麼這樣裁決；需回應分歧點 / Explain the decision and address disputed points.

minority_acknowledged.description: finding 中每一則 minority 意見都必須逐一回應 / Respond to every minority opinion in the finding.

response.description: accepted = 採納其論點；rejected = 不採納 / Accepted adopts the argument; rejected declines it.

next_review_by.description: decision=defer 時必填 / Required when decision is defer.
